method: Opaque-ID alternatives fixed with the first scores before arm-key access. First verdicts are never overwritten; alternatives are reported separately. Even accepting every stored packet cannot overcome the 7/7 retained and 22/23 fresh availability gates.

alternatives.reason: Treat direct handling of the massive altar by the king as over-literal agency rather than an allowed illustration of he brought/put.
Accept if Baasha remains supportable at the cessation instant; reject if selected presence necessarily inserts him into an abandoned aftermath after departure.
Require canon for an implied divine writer, rather than treating radiant names as a supported unnamed-pillar illustration with no depicted writer.
Accept if the late-day light is conditional to a later part of the explicit range; reject if that low-sun field is active in the fixed midday scene.
Treat the Son as acting off frame through inscription light, with formed canon applied only if a body is shown, rather than incompatible selected-stage depiction.
